items.q: IgA nephropathy investigations: light microscopy shows pure mesangioproliferative glomerulonephritis, while immunofluorescence shows:
items.exp: IF: pIgA1 in mesangium ± C3 deposits. (Book p774)

items.q: Conservative management targets: salt restriction <2 g Na+/day, protein 1 g/kg/day, BP control below:
items.exp: Salt <2 g Na+/day; protein 1 g/kg/day; manage HTN (BP <140/90); ACE inhibitor/ARBs for proteinuria control. (Book p774)

items.q: Steroid (short course oral) indications include proteinuria >1 g/day after 6 months of conservative management, nephrotic or RPGN (crescents) presentation, high E score and:
items.exp: Indications end with: no significant CKD (if GFR ≤30/sclerosis/atrophy → no steroids). (Book p774)

items.exp: Transplant: indication if CKD occurs; ↓ rate of recurrence post transplant. (Book p774)
